reason: Re-opened packet.js zhuangzi 20 --verse 16.27 (chapter 16, juan 18, revision 6365330). The text line 則深根寧極而待 is the Chinese of the key verse (‘fell back upon their own resources and waited’), preceded by 不當時命而大窮乎天下 (‘age unsuitable, mission at failure’), on which Guo Xiang says 此不能澹漠之時也. His note on 則深根寧極而待 has 雖有事之世，而聖人未始不澹漠也，故深根寧極而待其自為耳，斯道之所以不喪也 verbatim, and it carries every clause: the sage calm even in an age of affairs (‘busy age’ is a fair rendering of 有事之世), rooted deep, waiting for things to act of themselves (待其自為), so the Way is not lost (斯道之所以不喪). Nothing is added. The revised plain sense matches day.js 16.27 (the retired scholars did not hide; it was that the age was not suitable), repeats no four words of the key and no longer reads as the scholars blaming the times. No school needed, no comparison, tone neutral; the colon is not barred by the rules and the gate passes. verse.js ok (Zhuangzi 16.27, at 1447); entry-check ok, no errors or warns.
